quote: Claude Opus 4.6 is available today on claude.ai, our API, and all major cloud platforms.
note: Lab (Anthropic) and kind (shipped) notes confirmed. The announcement page on anthropic.com is Anthropic's own post, and the Feb 5, 2026 date comes from its dateline as read in a WebFetch summary; the quoted sentence is the availability line from that page, not the dated line itself. Corroborated by Google Cloud Vertex AI docs (https://docs.cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/partner-models/claude/opus-4-6), which give 'Release date: February 5, 2026', and by secondary coverage (letsdatascience, newsbytesapp). No preview or waitlist was found. The 1M-token context window was in beta at launch; this is a feature status, not a separate preview of the model. Anthropic's system-cards index (https://www.anthropic.com/system-cards) lists Opus 4.6 only as 'February 2026', so the day comes from the announcement and the vendor docs. Opus 4.6 has since been superseded by later Opus releases, which does not affect its release date.
queries: Claude Opus 4.6 system card released February 2026
